name: OtterIndicator
description: Ottie resting, quietly typing, tilting its head or celebrating. Wait/process loop only while visible. Error/finish play once on entry. Reduced motion shows a still pose. Give it an explicit square box, 40px or larger. Decorative by default; the consumer supplies the nearby status text.

name: Step
description: One step in `Steps`: a numbered marker, a title and a description.

props.name: description
props.description: Shown under the title. `children` override it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Keeps the step from being clicked when the steps are clickable.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the number of a step that is waiting or in progress.

props.name: status
props.description: Overrides the status the step gets from `current`.

name: Steps
description: Numbered steps through a process, as an ordered list of `Step`s. Each child is numbered by its position; the step at `current` gets `aria-current="step"`.

props.name: current
props.description: The current step, counted from 1. Steps before it are `finish`, after it `wait`, and the current one takes `status`. Leave it unset with `defaultCurrent` to let clicks move it.

props.name: errorIcon
props.description: Replaces the cross of failed steps.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: Screen-reader text read after a failed step's title.

props.name: finishIcon
props.description: Replaces the check mark of finished steps.

props.name: finishLabel
props.description: Screen-reader text read after a finished step's title.

props.name: onUpdateCurrent
props.description: Called with the clicked step's number. Setting it turns every step that isn't `disabled` into a button.

props.name: vertical
props.description: Lays the steps out in a column instead of a row.
